blocks.body: Ukraine struck the bridge linking Russia to Crimea again, in a barrage Kyiv says involved 1,336 drones, as Russia hit bridges in Kyiv in reply.
blocks.headline: KYIV HITS CRIMEA BRIDGE FOR SECOND DAY

blocks.body: Iran attacked a US military radar site in Bahrain with drones, and its Revolutionary Guard says it downed another US MQ-1 drone.
blocks.headline: IRAN DRONES TARGET US RADAR IN BAHRAIN

blocks.body: Washington now requires export licences for advanced AI chips sent to data centres that can serve firms in China or other restricted states.
blocks.headline: US CURBS AI-CHIP LEASING TO CHINA

blocks.body: The storm is set to strengthen into a severe cyclonic storm by 19 November, India's weather office warns, as it moves over the bay.
blocks.headline: CYCLONE AKVAN BEARS DOWN ON BAY OF BENGAL

blocks.body: London sanctioned firms tied to Israeli settlements in the West Bank, in a push to protect a two-state solution.
blocks.headline: BRITAIN SANCTIONS SETTLEMENT FIRMS

blocks.body: Nvidia hired a leading US law firm to examine claims involving chief executive Jensen Huang and a woman alleged to be a Beijing spy.
blocks.headline: NVIDIA PROBES CEO OVER ALLEGED SPY LINK

blocks.body: Anthropic plans to price its flotation this evening and begin trading on the Nasdaq on 19 November.
blocks.headline: ANTHROPIC TO PRICE ITS IPO TONIGHT

blocks.body: Google says it has spotted the first cyberattack carried out autonomously by AI, and warns the threat is growing.
blocks.headline: GOOGLE FLAGS FIRST AUTONOMOUS AI CYBERATTACK

blocks.body: Tallinn will close its border with Russia after an alleged sabotage attempt on a drone maker; Japan scrambled jets as suspected Russian planes entered its airspace.
blocks.headline: ESTONIA TO SHUT RUSSIA BORDER AFTER SABOTAGE BID

blocks.body: The US has recorded 5,412 measles cases and 10 deaths in 2026. Mississippi's health chief warns the state's first case in nearly 40 years is coming.
blocks.headline: MEASLES RETURNS AS US LOSES ELIMINATION STATUS

blocks.body: Researchers writing in Nature warn the developing 2026-27 El Nino could rank among the strongest in more than a century.
blocks.headline: SUPER EL NINO MAY BRING FOOD AND HEALTH CRISES

blocks.body: MS Dhoni ends his IPL playing career and becomes Chennai Super Kings mentor; Jay Shah is re-elected ICC chairman for a second term.
blocks.headline: DHONI CALLS TIME ON IPL CAREER

footer: THE DAILY GLOBE  •  Wednesday 18 November 2026  •  Headlines checked against fresh reporting and written in our own words. Sources named with each story.
in_brief: COP31: Denmark, Luxembourg, Spain, Portugal and Ireland announce fossil-fuel phase-out plans as talks run in Antalya until 20 Nov.
Modi presses India's Indo-Pacific vision at the East Asia Summit; India is re-elected to the ITU Council for 2027-2030.
Sudan's factories struggle to restart, three years after war halted production across Khartoum.
Ecuadorian fishermen sue Washington over secret US strikes on their boats.

lead.deck: The US president arrived in the Philippines for Quad talks ahead of a visit to China, as leaders gather for the APEC summit in Shenzhen and Xi meets Canada's Carney, with Ottawa and Beijing extending trade deals.
lead.headline: TRUMP LANDS IN MANILA AS ASIA'S SUMMIT WEEK OPENS

markets_note: US stocks, 16 Nov close; Nikkei, 17 Nov close. Brent $91.62 a barrel; the dollar hit a 19-month high; the yen neared 160 per dollar.

numbers.small: drones in Ukraine's barrage, Kyiv says
